messages:
ashley: PTAL on PR #4825 — RBAC rollout + deploy hooks. I addressed the review comments, added a small smoke test, and moved manifests to kustomize overlays. CI passed locally but want to coordinate merge timing since this touches infra automation and role bindings.

ben: Quick skim — LGTM overall. One nit about the smoke test timeout but not blocking.

samir: Looking now. Question: the cronjob TTL change might trigger restarts across clusters, can we gate that? pinging @morgan_s for release window preference.

morgan_s: Thanks for the ping. Prefer merging after 14:00 PST so we don't overlap with the morning deploys. Also need a rollback plan before we click merge.

ashley: Added rollback steps to the PR description under "Rollback plan". Example commands:```kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/rbac-controller --to-revision=<rev>``` and smoke run: ```./scripts/smoke_test.sh rbac```. I also tightened the smoke timeout.

ci-bot: Canary build passed (canary-7). E2E had one flake on pod startup that was fixed in the last commit.

rita: I can handle post-merge monitoring. Please tag me when you merge and add a quick line to release-notes/infra.md about the RBAC automation change.

ashley: Done — pushed the timeout fix, rebased on main, and added the release-notes entry. PTAL again @ben @samir when you have a sec.

ben: Approved and left a tiny comment about test naming. :+1:

samir: Approved. Minor logging verbosity suggestion, not blocking.

morgan_s: Approved for merge at 14:05 PST. I'll be in #eng-oncall around then to watch the rollout.

ashley: Plan: merge at 14:05 PST, monitor canary for 15m, then promote. I'll post status here and ping @rita. Thanks all :rocket:

ashley: Merged at 14:07 PST. Canary looks healthy, metrics are stable for the first 10m. Starting gradual rollout.

rita: Seeing expected metrics and no error spikes. Continuing to monitor for 30m. Will post final status when complete. :white_check_mark:
